label: Game experience
tagline: Living interactive worlds with an objective - agency, juice, score, feedback loop
description: Crafts full-bleed game-like immersive pieces where the user drives with drag / touch / multi-touch and the scene responds with physics + particle feedback toward a stated objective (score / progress / streak / win-condition). The fifth orchestrator sibling - inherits simulation-orchestrator's discipline (paradigm space, research-then-drawers shape, lens trio with loop-until-bar, multi-draft cruxes via iterator-remix, hand-off split). What changes is purpose: where simulation gives the user UNDERSTANDING of a system, interactive-media makes the body the creative material, and narrative-experience gives presence in a place - game-experience gives AGENCY toward an OBJECTIVE inside a LIVING WORLD. Three load-bearing words. Agency means input feels direct (drag / touch / multi-touch / gestures with ≤50ms response). Objective means a goal that climbs (score, progress, streak, level). Living world means full-bleed scenes with no flat resting state - ambient motion always, physics + particles + feedback on action, UI peeks at the edge and never frames the action. Five paradigms (2d-side / 2d-topdown / 3d-environment / iconographic-physics / hybrid) map onto game-experience naturally. Collaborates with visual-orchestrator for hero plates / sprites / texture atlases so every plate inherits the brief's styleCue. Concept-lens scores against felt-game-feel successFeel ('every throw feels weighty and the world rewards it'), never generic claims ('the user has fun'). Two cross-boundary contracts the orchestrator enforces beyond the per-drawer lens trios: §1.2 iframe ↔ host pointer + scroll contract (touch-action:none + mandatory scroll-past affordance for hero-slot games, HUD pointer-events budget, gesture-intent disambiguation, wheel forwarding, pointer-capture cleanup) and §5.6 Phase F layered-interaction QA + fix pass the chat caller runs after Step-8 QA - mandatory for every hero-slot game because touch-action:none + all-gestures-owned means every Phase F failure mode is in play simultaneously.

triggers.title: Game-like piece in a project
triggers.rule: User wants a game-like piece - anything with objective + feedback loop (score / progress / streak / win-condition / growth-payoff). Includes both arcade-physical patterns (throw / collect / dodge / aim) AND nurturing / companion / care-game patterns (Pou / Tamagotchi / Neko Atsume / Stardew animal-care / Finch / Pip's Glade / forest-feeding). Top-level Claude scaffolds the app shell with `<iframe class="game-mount" data-game=...>` slot + `allow=` attribute, then dispatches game-experience-orchestrator. Same shape as simulation-orchestrator - one consistent flow.
